title: ClueTracer: Question-to-Vision Clue Tracing for Training-Free Hallucination Suppression in Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.02004v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large multimodal reasoning models solve challenging visual problems via explicit long-chain inference: they gather visual clues from images and decode clues into textual tokens. Yet this capability also increases hallucinations, where the model generates content that is not supported by the input image or the question. To understand this failure mode, we identify \emph{reasoning drift}: during clue gathering, the model over-focuses on question-irrelevant entities, diluting focus on task-relevant cues and gradually decoupling the reasoning trace from visual grounding. As a consequence, many inference-time localization or intervention methods developed for non-reasoning models fail to pinpoint the true clues in reasoning settings. translated_title: ClueTracer：面向多模态推理中免训练幻觉抑制的“问题到视觉”线索追踪方法
translated_abstract: 大型多模态推理模型通过显式的长链推理来解决具有挑战性的视觉问题：它们从图像中收集视觉线索，并将线索解码为文本标记。然而，这种能力也加剧了幻觉问题，即模型生成的内容得不到输入图像或问题的支持。为了理解这种失败模式，我们识别出“推理漂移”现象：在线索收集过程中，模型过度关注与问题无关的实体，稀释了对任务相关线索的注意力，并逐渐使推理轨迹与视觉依据脱钩。因此，许多为非推理模型开发的推理时定位或干预方法难以在推理场景中准确定位真正的线索。受这些洞察启发，我们提出了ClueRecall——一个用于评估视觉线索检索能力的指标，并提出了ClueTracer——一个免训练、免参数、架构无关的插件，用于抑制幻觉。
tldr: 该论文发现多模态推理模型存在“推理漂移”这一幻觉根源，并提出免训练、免参数、架构无关的插件ClueTracer，通过将问题追踪至视觉线索来抑制幻觉，同时提出评估视觉线索检索能力的指标ClueRecall。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "reasoning drift" as the root cause of hallucinations in multimodal reasoning models and proposes ClueTracer, a training-free, parameter-free, architecture-agnostic plugin that traces questions back to visual clues to suppress hallucinations, together with ClueRecall, a metric for evaluating visual clue retrieval.
